items.say: It was cleaning day at the castle, and Hoot the owl had a lot to do. First, she polished the bell. Next, she folded the map. After that, she scrubbed the shield. Finally, she washed the boot. By dinner time, the castle was sparkling. Tap the four things in the order they happened.

It was cleaning day at the castle, and Boo the ghost had a lot to do. He folded the map. But before he did that, he shined the crown. After those two things, he polished the bell. Last of all, he dusted the chest. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.

Puff the dragon had three friends to visit. He planned to see Pounce the cat first, then Dash the fox, and Sir Clank the knight last. But Pounce was not home in the morning, so Puff went back and saw her last of all. Tap the friends in the order Puff really saw them.

Puff the dragon packed a bag for a long train ride. He put in a drum, a map, and a red heart. Then he changed his mind. He took out the red heart and put in a purple heart instead. Just before he left, he added a potion. Tap everything that is in the bag now.

It was cleaning day at the castle, and Pounce the cat had a lot to do. First, she washed the boot. Next, she folded the map. Then she wiped the drum. After that, she scrubbed the shield. Last of all, she put away the torch. By dinner time, the castle was sparkling. Tap the five things in the order they happened.

Sir Clank the knight set up camp in the forest at sunset. First, he unpacked the chest. Then he played the drum. At the very end, he lit the torch. But just before the end, he sipped the potion. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.

Pounce the cat had three friends to visit. She planned to see Puff the dragon first, then Sir Clank the knight, and Dash the fox last. But on the way, Pounce bumped into Dash, so Dash was the first one she saw. Tap the friends in the order Pounce really saw them.

Hoot the owl packed a bag for a trip to the beach. She put in a gem, a map, a flag, and a key. Then she changed her mind. She took out the map and the key. Just before she left, she added a sword. Tap everything that is in the bag now.

Hoot the owl spent the morning at the village market. To start with, she tapped on a drum. Next, she flipped through a book. Then she looked at a map. At the very end, she sniffed a potion. Then she walked home for lunch. Tap the four things in the order they happened.

Boo the ghost put on a magic show for the whole village. Before he made a ring spin in the air, he made a star glow. Last of all, he bent a key in half. But right before that, he made a potion bubble. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.

Pounce the cat had three friends to visit. She planned to see Sir Clank the knight first, then Boo the ghost, and Zazz the wizard last. But Boo was fast asleep, so Pounce skipped him and saw the other two. Tap the friends in the order Pounce really saw them.

Puff the dragon packed a bag for a camping trip. He put in a key, a potion, and a boot. Then he changed his mind. He took out the boot and put in an egg instead. Just before he left, he added a star. Tap everything that is in the bag now.

It was cleaning day at the castle, and Puff the dragon had a lot to do. First, he folded the map. Next, he shined the crown. Then he dusted the chest. After that, he polished the bell. Last of all, he scrubbed the shield. By dinner time, the castle was sparkling. Tap the five things in the order they happened.

Dash the fox set up camp in the forest at sunset. She checked the map. But before she did that, she put up the flag. After those two things, she lit the torch. Last of all, she played the drum. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.

Zazz the wizard had three friends to visit. He planned to see Boo the ghost first, then Sir Clank the knight, and Puff the dragon last. But Zazz started with the last friend, so he visited them the other way around. Tap the friends in the order Zazz really saw them.

Zip the robot packed a bag for a night at the castle. He put in a heart, a book, a bell, and a mushroom. Then he changed his mind. He took out the book and the mushroom. Just before he left, he added a drum. Tap everything that is in the bag now.

Dash the fox spent the morning at the village market. First, she tried on a hat. Next, she bought an egg. After that, she tried on a ring. Finally, she flipped through a book. Then she walked home for lunch. Tap the four things in the order they happened.

Sir Clank the knight was getting ready for the big parade. First, he put on the crown. Then he cleaned the muddy boot. At the very end, he polished the sword. But just before the end, he painted the shield. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.
